//! The tests of a C# test file (the unit's note names it), translated from C# (CodeCoreMorph, D-84): a `#[test]` per C#
//! test case, each mapped in rust/test-map.toml.

# The C# tests this port translated to Rust, and the Rust tests that took them over
# (CodeCoreMorph, D-84). One entry per C# test:
#
#   [[test]]
#   csharp = "dotnet:Shop.Tests.CartTests#AddTakesFromStock"
#   rust = "nextest:shop_rs::cart_tests::add_takes_from_stock"
#   note = "..."                           # optional
edits.replace:
# The C# tests this port translated to Rust, and the Rust tests that took them over
# (CodeCoreMorph, D-84). One entry per C# test:
#
#   [[test]]
#   csharp = "dotnet:Shop.Tests.CartTests#AddTakesFromStock"
#   rust = "nextest:shop_rs::cart_tests::add_takes_from_stock"
#   note = "..."                           # optional

[[test]]
csharp = "dotnet:Relay.Tests.CacheTests#AValueIsFetchedOnceThenKept"
rust = "nextest:relay_rs::cache_tests::a_value_is_fetched_once_then_kept"

[[test]]
csharp = "dotnet:Relay.Tests.CacheTests#ManyKeysAreFetchedAtOnceInTheirOrder"
rust = "nextest:relay_rs::cache_tests::many_keys_are_fetched_at_once_in_their_order"

[[test]]
csharp = "dotnet:Relay.Tests.CacheTests#AFailedFetchFaultsTheTaskWithTheStoresException"
rust = "nextest:relay_rs::cache_tests::a_failed_fetch_faults_the_task_with_the_stores_exception"
note = "the store is the test's own Rust double now, so the exception is the same object by its type and message, not by AreSame"

[[test]]
csharp = "dotnet:Relay.Tests.CacheTests#ANullValueIsRefused"
rust = "nextest:relay_rs::cache_tests::a_null_value_is_refused"

[[test]]
csharp = "dotnet:Relay.Tests.CacheTests#OneFailureFaultsTheWholeBatch"
rust = "nextest:relay_rs::cache_tests::one_failure_faults_the_whole_batch"

[[test]]
csharp = "dotnet:Relay.Tests.CacheTests#CancelingAFetchCancelsTheTask"
rust = "nextest:relay_rs::cache_tests::canceling_a_fetch_cancels_the_task"

[[test]]
csharp = "dotnet:Relay.Tests.CacheTests#NullKeysFaultTheTask"
rust = "nextest:relay_rs::cache_tests::null_keys_fault_the_task"
note = "a Rust string can't be null: the null key checks were the bridge's, and went with it; what is left is the null store"

[[test]]
csharp = "dotnet:Relay.Tests.CacheTests#ClearingForgetsTheValues"
rust = "nextest:relay_rs::cache_tests::clearing_forgets_the_values"

arguments.summary: Translated CacheTests.cs and its Stores.cs to Rust: the test stores implement the ported interface; each case mapped, two with notes.
